entities.name: Rediscovery of Orazca
entities.description: The unsealing and reawakening of the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of Orazca.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The ancient Golden City, once hidden by the River Heralds and the planar barrier.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The legendary power source in Orazca, created by Azor.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: The first vampire of the Legion of Dusk, who guarded the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire order seeking the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The faction led by Apatzec Intli III that reclaimed Orazca.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates who struggled for the city; scattered afterwards.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who hid Orazca.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk shaman who defied the River Heralds and awakened Orazca.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat-god in whose tomb Elenda slept.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Elenda encountered. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Elenda encountered. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Vona

entities.name: Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Elenda discovers the Immortal Sun in deserted Orazca and places herself in an enchanted sleep to guard it.
events.quote: Elenda placed herself in an enchanted sleep within a tomb of the bat- god Aclazotz

events.summary: Kumena reaches Orazca's gates and awakens the city and Elenda.
events.quote: There, he used his magic to awaken Orazca and the elder dinosaurs entombed within it.

events.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli, resolved to remind her people of their purpose.
events.quote: She first encountered the planeswalkers Angrath and Huatli

events.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein cast Kumena from the Tower of Triumph to seize the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Vona and Mavren Fein of the Legion of Dusk cast him from the Tower of Triumph

events.summary: Jace and Vraska learn from Azor that the barrier failed to contain Bolas, and conspire to remove the Immortal Sun with Tezzeret.
events.quote: they conspired to remove the artifact from the plane entirely, with Tezzeret stealing it through the Planar Bridge

events.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes through Tezzeret's portal; Elenda refuses to help the Legion recover it.
events.quote: Elenda refused to aid the Legion in recovering it, declaring their ancient burden fulfilled at last.

events.summary: The Sun's removal shatters Ixalan's planar seal; the Legion retreats, the Coalition scatters and the Sun Empire reclaims Orazca.
events.quote: The Sun Empire, led by Apatzec Intli III , reclaimed Orazca

relations.quote: Ixalan's hidden guardian and the Immortal Sun's creator
